svg.text: FIVE ORTHOGRAPHIC VIEWS / metres / design proxy v1 / same scale / solid colours are material IDs
Origin: shared local coordinates; front = -Z, up = +Y. Top view: -Z toward page top.
PORTS: 柱脚；灯朝路侧，不给每盏建 PointLight
DETAIL: 灯罩实体+自发光；少数关键灯带实际落光
COLLISION: 并入路缘；低碰撞避免卡路
VARIANTS: 暖白／青；光源另由总装预算管理
Planning drawing only. Not a production mesh, construction engineering drawing or measured reconstruction of the AI image.
